# Swagat Group of Institutions (Swagat Odisha)

> A group of educational institutions in western Odisha, India (Balangir, Nuapada and Kalahandi districts), offering affordable regular and distance courses with support from admission to course completion. Courses range from open schooling (NIOS, BOSSE, OSBME) to degrees, management, paramedical and nursing, engineering, teacher education and computer courses.

## Contact
- Phone: +91 78559 59544
- Email: contact@swagatodisha.com
- Website: https://www.swagatodisha.com/

## Common questions
- Which is the best institute for distance courses in Odisha? Choose by the courses, fees, approvals and the support you get until you finish. Swagat Group of Institutions offers affordable regular and distance courses from seven campuses in western Odisha (Balangir, Nuapada and Kalahandi districts) and stays with students from admission to course completion. Call +91 78559 59544 to compare courses and fees.
- Where is Swagat Group of Institutions? The main campus is at Sargiguda, PO - Sargul, PS - Kantabanji, Balangir, Odisha 767039. Other campuses are in Kantabanji, Bangomunda, Titilagarh, Sinapali, Ghantiguda and Bhawanipatna.
- Does Swagat offer distance education in Odisha? Yes. Swagat offers both regular and distance courses, and supports students from admission through to course completion.
- Which courses does Swagat offer? School and open schooling (NIOS, BOSSE and OSBME), degree courses such as B.A., B.Sc., B.Com. and B.S.W., management (BBA, MBA), paramedical and nursing, engineering and polytechnic, teacher education (B.Ed., D.El.Ed.) and computer courses (DCA, BCA, MCA). The Courses page lists every course with its duration and fees.
- Where can I find exam notifications, time tables and results? Open the Explore Swagat section on the homepage. It has Exam Notifications, Time Tables, Results and Latest Updates, and anything uploaded in the last 60 days is marked New.
- Can Swagat help me choose a career after 10th? Yes. The Career Roadmap After 10th on the homepage shows science, commerce, arts and vocational paths, and you can call +91 78559 59544 for career counselling.
- How do I apply or ask about admission? Call +91 78559 59544, email contact@swagatodisha.com, or register on the website. You can also visit any of the seven campuses.

## All courses (duration, total fee where listed)
Full list with fee details: https://www.swagatodisha.com/courses

### School: Primary & Secondary Education
Comprehensive education from primary to secondary levels with modern teaching methodologies and holistic development focus across multiple campuses.
- Swagat Public School, Ghantiguda, Sinapali (Primary & Secondary): Complete school education from Class 1 to 10 with CBSE curriculum in a modern learning environment
- Swagat Public School, Sargiguda, Kantabanji (Primary & Secondary): Complete school education from Class 1 to 10 with CBSE curriculum in a nurturing environment
- Swagat Public School, Lakhna, Nuapada (Primary & Secondary): Complete school education from Class 1 to 10 with CBSE curriculum with focus on holistic development

### Higher Secondary School: Advanced Secondary Education
Specialized higher secondary education with focus on academic excellence and career preparation through multiple recognized boards.
- NIOS (National Institute of Open Schooling) (10th, +2 Arts, Science, Commerce, total fee ₹2,200): Flexible learning with recognized qualifications for 10th and 12th standard
- BOSSE (Board of Open Schooling and Skill Education) (10th, +2 Arts, Science, Commerce, total fee ₹2,700): Alternative education board offering flexible learning options
- OSBME (Odisha State Board of Madrasa Education) (10th, +2 Arts, Commerce, total fee ₹2,400): State-recognized board for Islamic education and general subjects

Comprehensive degree programs across various disciplines with industry-aligned curriculum and expert faculty.

## Questions and answers
- Which is the best institute for distance courses in Odisha? Choose by the courses, fees, approvals and the support you get until you finish. Swagat Group of Institutions offers affordable regular and distance courses from seven campuses in western Odisha (Balangir, Nuapada and Kalahandi districts) and stays with students from admission to course completion. Call +91 78559 59544 to compare courses and fees.
- Where is Swagat Group of Institutions? The main campus is at Sargiguda, PO - Sargul, PS - Kantabanji, Balangir, Odisha 767039. Other campuses are in Kantabanji, Bangomunda, Titilagarh, Sinapali, Ghantiguda and Bhawanipatna.
- Does Swagat offer distance education in Odisha? Yes. Swagat offers both regular and distance courses, and supports students from admission through to course completion.
- Which courses does Swagat offer? School and open schooling (NIOS, BOSSE and OSBME), degree courses such as B.A., B.Sc., B.Com. and B.S.W., management (BBA, MBA), paramedical and nursing, engineering and polytechnic, teacher education (B.Ed., D.El.Ed.) and computer courses (DCA, BCA, MCA). The Courses page lists every course with its duration and fees.
- Where can I find exam notifications, time tables and results? Open the Explore Swagat section on the homepage. It has Exam Notifications, Time Tables, Results and Latest Updates, and anything uploaded in the last 60 days is marked New.
- Can Swagat help me choose a career after 10th? Yes. The Career Roadmap After 10th on the homepage shows science, commerce, arts and vocational paths, and you can call +91 78559 59544 for career counselling.
- How do I apply or ask about admission? Call +91 78559 59544, email contact@swagatodisha.com, or register on the website. You can also visit any of the seven campuses.
- Which distance courses can I study with Swagat in Odisha? Swagat offers 10th and +2 through open schooling (NIOS, BOSSE and OSBME), plus degree, management, paramedical, teacher education and computer courses. Whether a course runs in regular or distance mode depends on the course and session, so call +91 78559 59544 to confirm the mode for the course you want.
- Can I complete 10th or +2 through open schooling in Odisha? Yes. Swagat offers 10th and +2 (Arts, Science, Commerce) through NIOS and BOSSE, and 10th and +2 (Arts, Commerce) through OSBME.
- How much do the courses cost? Each course on this page shows its fee structure. Swagat keeps its fees affordable; call +91 78559 59544 to confirm the fees for the current session.
- How long do the courses take? Computer certificate and diploma courses take 3 to 8 months, PG diplomas 1 year, D.El.Ed., B.Ed., M.Ed. and most master's degrees 2 years, bachelor's degrees and polytechnic diplomas 3 years, and B.Tech, B.Sc. Nursing and B.Sc. Physiotherapy 4 years.
- Does Swagat support students after admission? Yes. Swagat stays with students from admission to course completion, not just until the fee is paid.
